subject: Critical: NebulaPay reserved throughput dipping under contracted baseline — exec attention requested
messages:
From: Sara Dunne <sara.dunne@nebulapay.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>; ops@nebulapay.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production errors + throughput falloff

Jonas / Redwood team —

We started seeing sustained throughput degradation across our reserved pool at ~08:00 PST. Traffic for our high-priority route is dropping to ~45-60 rps while our committed baseline is 120 rps. Concurrently we are observing higher 5xx error rates (primarily 503 and 504) and median tail latencies climbing from ~120ms to over 900ms for longer prompts. This is impacting live transactions and is causing payment timeouts for end users.

Timeline:
- 07:58 PST: first user complaints (timeouts)
- 08:00 PST: spikes in queue depth and token generation latency
- 08:05 PST: 5xx rate rising to 3.8% (from baseline 0.1%)

We attached a small packet of logs and traces (support_logs_0315.tar.gz, nebulapay_error_samples.json). Please escalate — we are on a tight go-live cadence today and need either immediate mitigation or a rollback path.

Requesting: 30-minute bridge ASAP, temporary burst to cover 2x baseline, and a firm timeline for resolution. Also want to understand if this is a reserved capacity shortfall vs. localized GPU saturation on Redwood side.

Sara Dunne
CTO, NebulaPay
Sara Dunne

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sara Dunne <sara.dunne@nebulapay.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, evelyn.hart@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 08:28:13 -0700
Subject: Re: Production errors + throughput falloff

Sara — thank you for the quick heads-up and the logs. Weve opened incident INC-20270315-NP and are treating this as P1. Im assigning an on-call bridge now.

Immediate actions taken (now):
- Enabled burst capacity for NebulaPay to cover 2x committed throughput (temporary policy for next 60 min).
- Flipped routing for the most impacted route to a compatible hosted variant to reduce per-request queueing while we triage the reserved pool.
- Marked the GPU nodes backing your reserved pool as "hot" for priority eviction avoidance.

Can you join a quick 30-min bridge at 08:45 PST? If not, we'll call the ops address you copied and loop infra-support.

We will follow up with a short update in 15 minutes and an incident note afterward. Apologies for the disruption — were prioritizing throughput restoration.

Jonas Weber
Head of Sales (Customer Escalations)
Redwood Inference

On Mon, Mar 15, 2027 at 08:12 Sara Dunne <sara.dunne@nebulapay.com> wrote:
> Jonas / Redwood team —
> 
> We started seeing sustained throughput degradation across our reserved pool at ~08:00 PST....

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, evelyn.hart@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 08:33:50 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: NebulaPay reserved pool under-delivery — immediate ops + exec heads-up

Team - internal notes and asks (do not forward to customer):

Summary: NebulaPay (deal NP-9821) experiencing reserved-capacity throughput falloff and elevated 5xx/latency at 07:58-08:05 PST. Customer already escalated. Weve briefly burst them to hosted capacity and rerouted a high-latency route to hosted variant to buy time.

Preliminary signals from logs: queue depth spiking before token generation, GPU utilization per node at ~98-100% on two nodes, scheduler backpressure on older kernel variants. No evidence yet of misrouted traffic from NebulaPay side.

Immediate asks: 
- Rishi: please coordinate with infra and bump reserved pool headroom by allocating spare nodes from the US pool and confirm by 08:50 PST. If hardware unavailable, prepare an automated fallback to transparent throttled-hosted routing for a longer window.
- Neha: draft the customer-facing incident summary and a short credit proposal (first-pass: pro-rata for outage window + goodwill credit).
- Evelyn: loop in Jamie (VP Ops) and ask for exec approval to apply a one-off credit if needed; prep an internal one-slide briefing for CRO/CEO.

We need an exec-visible summary by 09:00 PST with current impact metrics (lost rps, 5xx delta, tail latency). Ill coordinate the bridge and customer comms.

Jonas

From: Sara Dunne <sara.dunne@nebulapay.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>; ops@nebulapay.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:10:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Production errors + throughput falloff

Jonas / team —

Thanks for the rapid response and for opening INC-20270315-NP. We observed latency and errors drop quickly after you enabled burst and rerouted the route; throughput is back to ~115-125 rps for the last 10 minutes. Appreciate the fast mitigation.

Next requests:
- We need a timeline for a root-cause analysis (RCA) and planned remediation so this doesn't recur.
- Please share the incident note and relevant logs once available.
- We will expect a commercial remedy consistent with our SLA (pro-rata credits) given the production impact; please coordinate your finance/CS teams.

I can join a postmortem after 16:00 PST today if that helps.

Sara Dunne
CTO, NebulaPay

Attachments: support_logs_0315.tar.gz (provided earlier)
